verdict.rationale: CDP documents a Sandbox as a fully isolated testing environment for custodial features that needs no real funds. Custodial payouts and conversions likely fall within that scope, but the pack never says so explicitly, and it scopes the sandbox only to custodial features. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox coverage of payment acceptance, payouts and conversions (non-custodial flows appear excluded); documented deterministic test values or magic amounts; independent or hands-on corroboration.
